programs.programZh: 北美學徒計劃（美國／加拿大）
programs.eligibilityZh: 「You must be at least 18 years old with a high school diploma or equivalent—we’re actively seeking applicants without a four-year degree. And you must be eligible to work in the US or Canada without sponsorship.」（摘譯：年滿 18 歲、具高中文憑或同等學力；主動徵求沒有四年制學位的申請者；須具美國或加拿大工作資格，不提供簽證擔保）
programs.offersZh: 「You’ll be on a supportive team with structured training, mentorship and on-the-job learning. Enjoy competitive compensation benefits coverage for you and your dependents. Plus, unlock ongoing career opportunities with Accenture upon completing the program.」（摘譯：結構化培訓、導師與在職學習；具競爭力的薪酬與涵蓋家屬的福利；完成後可獲持續職涯機會）
programs.sourceTitle: Accenture 官方：Company Apprenticeship Programs
programs.notesZh: 繞過大學性質：是（官方明示「actively seeking applicants without a four-year degree」，高中文憑即可）。對象不限應屆高中畢業生，官方案例多為轉職成人；官方頁稱「In 2016, we launched a professional apprenticeship program」並佔其美加入門級招聘 20%。建議 kind=apprenticeship（非學位）。｜officialUrl 抓取 2026-11-07 HTTP 200 SHA-256 032b49c8c83030c7…（全值見 sources.json）；計劃同時在加拿大招募（programZh 已標）；regionZh 取總部所在國

programs.programZh: 英國學徒制與離校生計劃
programs.eligibilityZh: 「If you’ve completed, or are in the process of completing, your GCSEs or National 5s, our Level 3 engineering apprenticeships can help you develop skills in areas such as fitting, welding and maintenance. If you’ve completed, or are in the process of completing, your A-levels, Highers, or equivalent, our Degree or Higher [Apprenticeships]…」（摘譯：完成或即將完成 GCSE 可申請 Level 3 工程學徒；完成或即將完成 A-level 可申請 Higher／Degree 學徒）
programs.offersZh: 「Earn a competitive salary with annual pay rises」；官方頁薪資表（Correct as of April 2026）：Advanced/Modern Apprenticeship 第 1–4 年 £18,316.40／£20,927.22／£23,908.65／£27,316.88；Advanced Apprenticeship: Solihull £16,495.53→£30,294.01；Higher Apprenticeship £21,512.27→£32,082.58；Degree Apprenticeship £23,932.59→£34,831.86
programs.sourceTitle: Rolls-Royce 官方：UK Apprenticeships & School Leaver Programmes
programs.notesZh: 繞過大學性質：Level 3／Higher 學徒不含學位（是）；Degree Apprenticeship 為在職取得學士（雇主資助學位路徑），需站長決定是否算「直招」。degree=partial 表示同一入口含兩類，入庫可拆為兩條。同站另有德國學徒頁 careers.rolls-royce.com/en/students-and-graduates/germany/apprenticeships-and-school-leavers（已抓取，未另立條目）。｜officialUrl 抓取 2026-11-07 HTTP 200 SHA-256 f47d062d56b62624…（全值見 sources.json）

programs.programEn: Apprenticeships in the United Kingdom (Engineering, Digital & Manufacturing)
programs.programZh: 英國學徒制（工程／數位／製造，Level 2–6）
programs.eligibilityZh: 「Typically, for our Craft and Technician apprenticeships, you will need a minimum of five GCSEs at Grade 4 or C (or equivalent), which must include maths, English language, and a science. For our Degree apprenticeships, you will also need A-Levels or a BTEC (or equivalents).」（摘譯：技工／技術員學徒通常需五科 GCSE 達 4 級或 C，含數學、英語與一科科學；學位學徒另需 A-Level 或 BTEC）；「Our apprenticeship roles do not meet the minimum requirements set by UK Visas & Immigration to enable sponsorship of migrant workers.」（摘譯：不提供外籍勞工簽證擔保）
programs.offersZh: 「you will have a salary, hands-on training, and an academic or vocational qualification」「We offer a competitive salary and generous holiday allowance. Many of our apprenticeships, especially in digital and corporate roles, also offer hybrid working and flexible hours.」；頁面列出 Level 2 至 Level 6 多個計劃（例：Machining Craft Apprenticeship (Level 3)、Customer Service Engineering Degree Apprenticeship (Level 6)）
programs.sourceTitle: Airbus 官方：Engineering, Digital & Manufacturing Apprentices（UK）
programs.notesZh: 繞過大學性質：Level 2–4 學徒不含學位（是）；Level 5–6 Degree Apprenticeship 在職取得學位。官方明示不擔保簽證，對非英籍學生意義有限。頁面記 2026 申請時程：「Digital, business, engineering, project management and procurement degree apprenticeships closed on 26 October」「Level 3 roles in Broughton - 26 January to 4 February and 15 to 19 February」。｜officialUrl 抓取 2026-11-07 HTTP 200 SHA-256 a14de0e2942c39a4…（全值見 sources.json）

programs.programZh: 英國學徒計劃（審計／稅務／科技／諮詢／商業服務）
programs.eligibilityZh: 官方總覽頁未列具體學歷門檻；頁面定位：「The opportunity to earn a salary while working towards a fully-funded qualification is an ideal alternative to traditional university.」（摘譯：邊領薪邊取得全額資助的資格，是傳統大學之外的理想替代）
programs.offersZh: 「If you join us in Audit or Tax, by the end of your apprenticeship you’ll have the same qualifications as our graduate colleagues」「in just five years, you will have become professionally qualified」「KPMG Business Services offer a two year apprenticeship programme」「Each of our apprentices has six days a year of volunteering leave.」

programs.notesZh: 繞過大學性質：是（官方明寫 alternative to traditional university，取得專業資格而非學位；是否含學位學徒頁面未寫）。入學門檻須到各職缺頁核，故 confidence=medium。｜officialUrl 抓取 2026-11-07 HTTP 200 SHA-256 d6afb2d20da8248f…（全值見 sources.json）

programs.programEn: Apprenticeships in Switzerland (commercial / ICT / BEM bank entry programme for high school graduates / IT-way-up)
programs.programZh: 瑞士學徒制（商業／ICT／高中畢業生銀行入門計劃 BEM）
programs.eligibilityZh: 申請文件（官方頁）：「Banking apprenticeship (commercial apprenticeship): School reports or learning reports (Canton of Bern) from the last two school years」「ICT apprenticeships: School reports from the last two school years」「BEM – Bank entry programme for high school graduates: For academic high school graduates: Matura certificate or reports from the last three semesters」（摘譯：商業／ICT 學徒須附最近兩學年成績單；BEM 面向高中 Matura 畢業生）
programs.offersZh: 「Our 3-year commercial apprenticeship will give you diverse learning experiences, whether it’s in Retail or Corporate Banking, Wealth Management, Human Resources, Operations, Remote Sales or Client Solutions.」「[ICT] These 4-year apprenticeships let you train on campus in Zurich or Manno (TI).」「IT-way-up… This 2-year program will get you programming.」「Many of our apprentices transition into permanent positions or decide to go deeper into their expertise with our 2-year junior talent program JUNA.」
programs.sourceTitle: UBS 官方：Apprenticeships in Switzerland
programs.notesZh: 繞過大學性質：是（瑞士雙元制學徒 EFZ，企業直招義務教育畢業生；BEM 專收高中 Matura 畢業生）。薪資頁面未寫，paid=unknown。｜officialUrl 抓取 2026-11-07 HTTP 200 SHA-256 f724f0a39ea2de6d…（全值見 sources.json）

programs.programEn: UK School Leaver apprenticeships (Degree apprenticeships with the University of Exeter)
programs.programZh: 英國離校生學徒制（含 Exeter 大學學位學徒）
programs.eligibilityZh: 「GCSEs or equivalent qualifications in English Language (5 or above) and Mathematics (6 or above)」「Grade requirements for each program vary depending on the business area. Applications are accepted and considered on a rolling basis.」（摘譯：GCSE 英語 5 以上、數學 6 以上；各業務線成績要求不同，滾動收件）
programs.offersZh: 「As a school leaver apprentice at UBS, you’ll be a full-time employee. Your role will be a mixture of learning, development, and on-the-job desk duties.」「These 4-year apprenticeships are carried out in partnership with the University of Exeter… You’ll begin with a Level 4 Investment Operations Specialist apprenticeship, the[n] progress onto a Level 6 Financial Services Professional apprenticeship.
